detail.question: Quels sont les dix produits les plus vendus, en nombre d'articles ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    oi.product_id AS produit,
    COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categorie,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_articles_vendus
FROM entrepot."order_items" AS oi
LEFT JOIN entrepot."products" AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN entrepot."product_category_name_translation" AS t
    ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
GROUP BY
    oi.product_id,
    COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
ORDER BY nombre_articles_vendus DESC
LIMIT 10

detail.question: Quelles sont les dix categories de produits qui rapportent le plus, en euros ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categorie,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS chiffre_affaires,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_articles_vendus
FROM entrepot."order_items" AS oi
JOIN entrepot."products" AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN entrepot."product_category_name_translation" AS t
    ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
JOIN entrepot."orders" AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC
LIMIT 10

detail.question: Combien de commandes par mois en 2017 ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    date_trunc('month', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS mois,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_commandes
FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
WHERE TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY mois
ORDER BY mois
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires mois par mois en 2018 ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    strftime(TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m') AS mois,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS chiffre_affaires,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2) AS frais_de_port,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS nb_commandes
FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
JOIN entrepot."order_items" AS oi
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) <  TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01'
  AND o.order_status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Quel jour de la semaine recoit le plus de commandes ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    CASE date_part('dow', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Dimanche'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Lundi'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Mardi'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Mercredi'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Jeudi'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Vendredi'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Samedi'
    END AS jour_de_semaine,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_commandes
FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
WHERE TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, date_part('dow', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))

detail.question: Quelles categories de produits ont le panier moyen le plus eleve, avec leur nom en anglais ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH lignes AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_id,
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categorie,
        SUM(oi.price) AS montant_commande
    FROM entrepot."order_items" AS oi
    JOIN entrepot."products" AS p
      ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    LEFT JOIN entrepot."product_category_name_translation" AS t
      ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
    WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.order_id, COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
)
SELECT
    categorie AS categorie_anglais,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_commandes,
    ROUND(AVG(montant_commande), 2) AS panier_moyen,
    ROUND(SUM(montant_commande), 2) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM lignes
GROUP BY categorie
ORDER BY panier_moyen DESC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Les vendeurs de quels etats livrent le plus vite ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    s.seller_state AS etat_vendeur,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS nb_commandes_livrees,
    ROUND(AVG(
        DATE_DIFF('hour',
            TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP),
            TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)
        ) / 24.0
    ), 2) AS delai_moyen_jours,
    ROUND(MEDIAN(
        DATE_DIFF('hour',
            TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP),
            TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)
        ) / 24.0
    ), 2) AS delai_median_jours
FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
JOIN entrepot."order_items" AS oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN entrepot."sellers" AS s
    ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.seller_state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 30
ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours ASC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Y a-t-il des doublons dans la table de geolocalisation ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH doublons AS (
    SELECT
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_state,
        COUNT(*) AS nb_occurrences
    FROM entrepot."geolocation"
    GROUP BY
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_state
)
SELECT
    SUM(nb_occurrences)                                        AS lignes_totales,
    COUNT(*)                                                   AS lignes_distinctes,
    SUM(nb_occurrences) - COUNT(*)                             AS lignes_en_double,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nb_occurrences > 1)                 AS combinaisons_dupliquees,
    MAX(nb_occurrences)                                        AS nb_max_repetitions,
    ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(nb_occurrences) - COUNT(*)) / SUM(nb_occurrences), 2) AS pct_lignes_en_double
FROM doublons
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Combien de commentaires mentionnent un probleme de livraison ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH commentaires AS (
    SELECT
        review_id,
        lower(strip_accents(COALESCE(review_comment_title, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(review_comment_message, ''))) AS texte
    FROM entrepot."order_reviews"
    WHERE COALESCE(review_comment_title, '') <> ''
       OR COALESCE(review_comment_message, '') <> ''
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS nb_commentaires_probleme_livraison,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commentaires) AS nb_commentaires_non_vides,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commentaires), 0), 1) AS part_pourcent
FROM commentaires
WHERE texte LIKE '%atras%'          -- atraso, atrasado, atrasada
   OR texte LIKE '%nao chegou%'
   OR texte LIKE '%nao recebi%'
   OR texte LIKE '%nao foi entregue%'
   OR texte LIKE '%nao entregue%'
   OR texte LIKE '%demora%'
   OR texte LIKE '%ainda nao%'
   OR texte LIKE '%prazo%'
   OR texte LIKE '%extraviad%'
   OR texte LIKE '%correio%'
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Le delai de livraison depend-il de l'etat du client ?

SELECT

    ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day',
        TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP),

detail.question: Le chiffre d'affaires du second semestre 2017 est-il superieur a celui du premier ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH commandes_2017 AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS date_achat
    FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
    WHERE TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) <  TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01 00:00:00'
),
ca_par_semestre AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN MONTH(c.date_achat) <= 6 THEN 'S1 2017' ELSE 'S2 2017' END AS semestre,
        SUM(i.price) AS chiffre_affaires,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.order_id) AS nombre_commandes
    FROM commandes_2017 AS c
    JOIN entrepot."order_items" AS i ON i.order_id = c.order_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    semestre,
    ROUND(chiffre_affaires, 2) AS chiffre_affaires,
    nombre_commandes,
    ROUND(chiffre_affaires - MIN(chiffre_affaires) OVER (), 2) AS ecart_avec_le_semestre_le_plus_faible
FROM ca_par_semestre
ORDER BY semestre
LIMIT 1000

  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Quel trimestre de 2018 a le mieux marche en volume ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    CAST(QUARTER(TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS VARCHAR) AS trimestre,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS nombre_de_commandes
FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
WHERE YEAR(TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2018
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY nombre_de_commandes DESC
LIMIT 1000
